en-US.title: Bawi Shopping
en-US.subtitle: Ethiopian fashion marketplace
en-US.description:
Discover fashion and Habesha styles on Bawi Shopping. Explore clothing, shoes, bags, jewelry, and accessories from independent sellers. Browse new arrivals and collections, or explore dedicated Women, Men, Girls, Boys, and Baby departments.

Save pieces to your wishlist, build your cart, and view prices in Ethiopian birr. Delivery is available within Ethiopia. Some destinations have a delivery fee shown at checkout; for others, Bawi confirms a courier quote after you place your order. You can review the full total before paying by Telebirr, then upload payment confirmation and follow your order status in the app.

Sellers can apply to join, manage products, and track fulfillment. Bawi also offers product search, saved addresses, order updates, and language choices including English, Amharic, Tigrinya, Afaan Oromo, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese. Product selection and delivery timing depend on availability.
en-US.promoText: Discover fashion and Habesha styles. Browse Women, Men, Girls, Boys, and Baby collections, save favorites, and shop in ETB.
